title: Cyclic orbit root model over an ind-etale local limit
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring, g a nonzerodivisor with R/(g) regular, and n>0 invertible in R. Let p:Y→Spec R factor through D(g). Suppose that the pullback of Y along the punctured root cover R[t]/(t^n-g) is a disjoint union of d copies of that punctured cover, with the isomorphism respecting its projection. Let y∈Spec R contain g. Then p is affine and locally of finite presentation. There exist a commutative ring H in the same universe, an ind-etale ring map ι:R→H, and x∈Spec H with Spec(ι)(x)=y, and a finite list of positive integers e(k) invertible in H. The base change Y×_R Spec H is isomorphic over Spec H to the basic open D(ι(g)) in the spectrum of the product of H[t]/(t^e(k)-ι(g)). The proof constructs H as the strict henselization at y; only its ind-etaleness, point, and orbit model are needed downstream.

proof.text: Proof: Put U=D(g). The punctured root cover V→U is finite free of positive rank n. The root and n are units there, so its derivative is a unit and the cover is etale. It is faithfully flat. Descend the given trivial finite etale cover along V→U to see that the factor j:Y→U is finite etale. Thus Y is affine and finitely presented as an R-scheme: U is the spectrum of the one-element localization of R, and j is finite and finitely presented. In particular p is affine and locally of finite presentation, which are the two properties required by the later descent step.

proof.text: Take H to be the strict henselization of R at y, with structural map ι and its closed point x. The map ι is ind-etale and Spec(ι)(x)=y. Flatness preserves regular multiplication by g; regularity of R and R/(g) passes to the strict henselization. The image of g is in the maximal ideal and is prime, since H/(g) is a regular local domain. The algebra C=H[t]/(t^n-ι(g)) is local: its closed fibre has the only prime (t). It is strictly henselian, t is regular, and C/(t)=H/(g) is regular, so C is a regular local domain. Its puncture is connected and normal. Hensel lifting the simple residue roots of X^n-1 gives the n-th roots of unity in H and a cyclic group G of order n. The action t↦ζt makes the punctured root cover a connected G-torsor.

proof.text: Pull the supplied splitting to H. Its descent data give a permutation action of G on Fin d. Decompose this finite set into orbits, indexed by Fin m. An orbit length e(k) is positive and divides n, hence is a unit in H. Its stabilizer fixes s=t^(n/e(k)). Eisenstein at (g) identifies the intermediate fraction field as the field generated by s, of degree e(k). The algebra H[s]/(s^e(k)-ι(g)) is regular local, and its puncture is normal. Both it and the orbit cover are the integral closure of H[1/g] in that field, giving the isomorphism over H[1/g]. Taking the finite product of the root algebras gives γ and its projection identity. This calculation stops at the ind-etale limit; it asserts no etale finite-stage model.

theorem root_split_cover_indEtale_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hj : ∃ j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g),
      j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) (hy : g ∈ y.asIdeal) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    (IsAffineHom p ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation p) ∧
    ∃ (H : CommRingCat.{u}) (ι : R →+* H) (x : Spec H),
      ι.IndEtale ∧
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) x = y ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : H)) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g)))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap H (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ e k - Polynomial.C (ι g))) (ι g))
        ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
